_readme: All pub-specific content lives here. null = unknown, and the UI hides it quietly. After editing run `node tools/build.js` to refresh the static HTML (the page also re-reads this file in the browser). See README.md.

site.name: Cask & Barrel
site.description: Concept website design for Cask & Barrel, a real ale pub at 137 High Street, Yarm. Rotating cask ales, wines and single malts. Not the pub's official site.

geo.note: From an OpenStreetMap Nominatim lookup of 137 High Street, Yarm (building centroid). Approximate; check on site.

site.locationNote: At the north end of the High Street, close to bus routes.

hero.headline: Real ale, proper pub.
hero.lead: Rotating cask ales, fine wines and single malts in the heart of Yarm. Pull up a stool, have a pint and a chat.

hours._note: Taken from public listings (Wed–Sat 12:00–22:00, Mon & Tue closed). Sunday is not confirmed: null hides it. Use {"closed": true} or {"open":"12:00","close":"22:00"}.

board.emptyText: Our casks change often – ask at the bar what's pouring.

about.heading: A traditional pub for a new generation
paragraphs: Cask & Barrel is a pub on Yarm High Street, built around a rotating line-up of real ales on six hand pulls, with wines and single malts alongside.
Come in for a quiet afternoon pint or an evening with friends.

facts.title: Six hand pulls
facts.text: Changing real ales, often including porter and stout.

facts.title: Wines & single malts
facts.text: A carefully chosen range alongside the cask line-up.

menu.heading: A dram or a glass
menu.intro: The cask ales are on the board above. For something else: a style guide to wines and single malts, to help you choose.
